subject: Fixes server crash when RDMA benchmark clients disconnect (#3448)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c: it fixes pending_list corruption (double-add and premature node removal) when an RDMA client disconnects. Exercising it requires a BUILD_RDMA build, RDMA hardware or the rdma_rxe soft-RoCE kernel module (root-only, unavailable in these runs), and a client connecting over RDMA. The fuzzer's installed components all connect over TCP/unix sockets and never enter the RDMA transport, and a proposed experiment can only compose those components, so no scenario can reach the changed code; any scenario written would pass without testing the fix.
